name: passport-validity-check
title: Passport Validity Check
description: Passport check against the destination's rule (6 months, Schengen's 3 months after leaving and 10 years since issue, blank pages) that names the exact date it must last until and offers the latest return that would pass. Default rules carry sources and can be replaced.

meta.summary: Checks a passport against the destination's validity rule and names the date it must last until, so a trip isn't booked that the passport can't make.
catches: Validity shorter than the destination needs, from arrival or departure
Schengen: issued more than 10 years before arrival
Not enough blank or facing pages
Latest return date that would still pass
limits: Built-in rules cover a few destinations and can change; airlines may apply stricter rules
Doesn't check visas or transit rules
a11y: Expiry, issue date and pages inputs have visible labels

sources.label: ICA Singapore: Entering Singapore (at least 6 months' validity)

rules.note: Informational; check the official source. Only the Singapore rule was confirmed this round. EUR-Lex blocked automated fetches, so the Schengen 3-month/10-year rule and the South Africa rule (dha.gov.za) were not re-verified.
